prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic sun-drenched tropical poolside portrait with a black triangle bikini, blonde hair and hard daylight, preserving the side-profile adjustment pose.
prompt.main_subject: One original approved adult woman with long wavy blonde hair, realistic natural skin texture and a gentle downward gaze. She wears a minimalist black two-piece triangle bikini and a single gold bangle. Preserve a natural feminine silhouette and side profile without exaggerated measurements or explicit body emphasis.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 portrait from mid-thigh upward. The adult subject stands beside the pool in left-facing side profile, looks down toward the water and lightly adjusts the side straps with both hands. Include detailed stone coping, clear turquoise water, dense tropical foliage, palm trees, modern dark fence and bright blue sky; no hat or headwear.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Strong direct natural sunlight creates defined but realistic shadows, warm highlights and clear hair and skin texture. Keep the mood candid, luxurious and tropical.
prompt.technical_specs: 9:16 vertical professional-photo feel, sharp subject and environmental detail, realistic true-to-life color, natural reflections in water and restrained contrast.
